title: ObjectGenericDAE: ODE2, ODE1 and algebraic equations on the coordinates of its nodes, linear terms and Python user functions
author: Claude-JG
description: Revision2026c step RG9.10.3 of #3143. The item on nodeNumbersODE2, nodeNumbersODE1 and nodeNumbersAE (NodeGenericAE for the multipliers, as the assembly gives bodies algebraic coordinates through their nodes only); the matrices M, D, K, E, A, B, B_t, C_q, C_y and the vectors f, g, c0; forceUserFunction and rhsUserFunction with (mbs, t, itemNumber, q, q_t, y, parameters); analytic Jacobians of the matrices, numerical for a block with a user function. The initial accelerations keep the ODE1 rows uncoupled. Checked against ObjectGenericODE2, ObjectGenericODE1, CoordinateConstraint and SolveGeneralizedAlpha.
releaseNotes: ObjectGenericDAE: ODE2, ODE1 and algebraic equations on the coordinates of its nodes (ODE2 nodes, NodeGenericODE1, NodeGenericAE for the multipliers), linear terms by matrices, forceUserFunction and rhsUserFunction; the initial accelerations of the implicit solver keep the ODE1 rows uncoupled from the algebraic equations
